page.notes: The first word "hammedem" is a fragment: the initial M is cut off at the edge, kept as printed. Arabic and Greek-like passages are copied as far as legible; the Arabic in the margin notes and some vowel-less Arabic words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The margin note marked "*" is set beside the line "* ultimus" in the text. Note "c. de الامامية" is beside the line "Porrò ita distingui". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "difparuit", "indiciis,de" and similar forms are transcribed with the long s as s. Google watermark at bottom right omitted.
